name: Gilded Drake — up to one target: with the target cleared, nothing is exchanged
notes: "… exchange control of this creature and up to one target creature an opponent controls." (2026-10-18.) params.exchangeTargeted.upToOneB lets the modal's Apply clear B ("No target"), which sets the pair to the Drake and nothing; the engine then exchanges nothing. Here a target is chosen and then cleared, as the modal does.
